breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions, specifying both Dirichlet (u=0 on all edges) and periodic conditions. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only includes the Dirichlet boundary condition, stating 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions with u=0 on all four edges of the domain', thus resolving the inconsistency.
